about.tagline: Learning Security Monitoring, Networking, Threat Detection, and Incident Response Through Hands-On Practice.
about.heroIntro: Cybersecurity undergraduate with a strong interest in Security Operations Center (SOC) operations, network security, threat detection, and incident response. Dedicated to hands-on investigation, network packet inspection, and defensive security practices.
about.bioParagraph1: I am a Cyber Security undergraduate at Erode Sengunthar Engineering College with a strong interest in Security Operations Center (SOC) operations, network security, threat detection, and incident response.
about.bioParagraph2: I am building my cybersecurity knowledge through structured learning, networking fundamentals, security tools, hands-on exercises, and security-focused projects.
about.bioParagraph3: I have gained exposure to cybersecurity through an internship at Codec Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and a Cybersecurity Analyst Job Simulation by Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), where I explored Identity and Access Management (IAM).
about.bioParagraph4: My goal is to develop practical SOC Analyst skills and contribute to identifying, investigating, and responding to security threats.
about.cardObjectiveDesc: Seeking an entry-level SOC Analyst or Cybersecurity Internship opportunity where I can apply my foundational knowledge, strengthen my investigation skills, and gain practical experience in security operations.
about.cardSocDesc: Focusing on security monitoring concepts, alert analysis fundamentals, threat triage, and incident response procedures through structured defensive scenarios.
about.cardNetworkDesc: Building strong foundations in TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, IP addressing, and network ports to inspect packets and identify anomalies.
about.cardIamDesc: Practical exploration of Identity & Access Management (IAM) fundamentals, strategy assessment, and authentication safeguards including 2FA, session security, and hashing.

projects.title: SecureWatch – Secure Login & Authentication System
projects.desc: Developed a secure authentication app with registration, login/logout, session management, and email-based Two-Factor Authentication (2FA). Implemented bcrypt password hashing, CSRF protection, SQL injection prevention measures, OTP expiration, rate limiting, and account lockout to defend against authentication attacks.

projects.title: Web Vulnerability Scanner
projects.desc: Built a full-stack web security scanner to identify common vulnerabilities and security weaknesses including SQL injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), open ports, hidden directories, and missing security headers. Features an interactive security dashboard with scan history, risk-level analysis, and automated PDF & HTML security reports.

projects.title: PhishGuard AI – Phishing Detection Model
projects.desc: A machine learning threat detection classifier that inspects email headers and body content using NLP vectorization, predicting threat probability and classifying email threat levels for faster investigation.

projects.title: CyberGuard – Password Security & Entropy Analyzer
projects.desc: An interactive client-side credential utility that evaluates password entropy, character diversity, and vulnerability patterns to educate users on defense-in-depth credential protection.
